changes.title: Art hash deep
items: Changes to the creatures, trees and props now always show after an update (no more old drawings kept from before)

changes.title: Creature biome looks
items: Nine creatures dressed for their new homes: a fire beetle, a tarantula, a jungle python, a sand cat, a smooth-coated otter, a fruit bat, a black bear, a spotted owl, and the moth is now a swallowtail butterfly

changes.title: Sphinx
items: The south's fantastic creature: the sphinx, in a desert ruin of buried streets and fallen columns, its legend winged and crowned with a cobra
